# AgroScan AI

AgroScan AI is an AI-powered crop health detection and decision-support platform for African farmers.

## Website
https://agroscanai.pxxlspace.cv/

## About
https://agroscanai.pxxlspace.cv/about
## YouTube
https://www.youtube.com/@miracletech53

## Purpose
AgroScan AI uses AI-powered image analysis to help users identify possible crop diseases, visible symptoms, severity, and recommended next steps.

## Important note
AI-generated results are preliminary and intended for informational and decision-support purposes. Users should confirm diagnoses with qualified agricultural experts before taking treatment action.
